certifications.proof_quote: Docusign is ISO 27001:2022, ISO 27017:2015 and 27018:2019 certified

certifications.name: ISO 27018:2019 (Cloud Privacy)
certifications.proof_quote: Docusign is ISO 27001:2022, ISO 27017:2015 and 27018:2019 certified

certifications.proof_quote: Docusign complies with the reporting requirements stipulated by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA) Trust Services Criteria

certifications.name: SOC 1 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 1 Type II and SOC 2 Type II Docusign complies with the reporting requirements stipulated by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA) Trust Services Criteria

certifications.name: PCI DSS v4.0
certifications.proof_quote: Docusign maintains compliance with version 4.0 of the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

certifications.name: FedRAMP Agency Authorization
certifications.proof_quote: Docusign was awarded the FedRAMP Agency authorization and is listed on the U.S. Federal Government's FedRAMP marketplace

certifications.name: GovRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: Docusign Federal (eSignature & IAM) and Docusign CLM have achieved GovRAMP authorization.

certifications.name: DoD IL4 (Impact Level 4)
certifications.proof_quote: Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) granted Docusign an IL4 provisional authorization for several offerings, including Docusign Federal (eSignature) and Docusign Contract Lifecycle Management.

certifications.name: HIPAA (BAA available)
certifications.proof_quote: With the correct configuration, Docusign eSignature can be HIPAA compliant for healthcare and life sciences organizations.

certifications.name: GDPR (Binding Corporate Rules + EU SCCs)
certifications.proof_quote: Docusign obtained approval of its applications for Binding Corporate Rules (BCRs) as both a data processor and data controller from the European Union Data Protection Authorities.

certifications.name: CSA STAR (CAIQ Level 1 self-assessment)
certifications.proof_quote: Docusign completes the Consensus Assessments Initiative Questionnaire (CAIQ) annually which documents the rigor and strength of DocuSign's security posture and best practices and is publicly accessible for viewing and download from the CSA STAR registry.

certifications.name: BSI C5 Type II (German cloud security)
certifications.proof_quote: C5 Type II compliance validates Docusign's eSignature product security program and controls meet the requirements of the Federal Office for Information Security (BSI).

certifications.name: IRAP PROTECTED (Australia)
certifications.proof_quote: Docusign has completed a third-party assessment and meets the PROTECTED level requirements, aligning with both the Australian Government Information Security Manual (ISM) controls and the Protective Security Policy Framework (PSPF).

certifications.name: APEC Privacy Recognition for Processor (PRP)
certifications.proof_quote: Docusign has achieved the APEC Privacy Recognition for Processor (PRP) System certification

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on docusign.com. Docusign publishes AI Innovation Principles and a trusted AI approach page but does not claim ISO 42001 certification.

certifications.name: CSA STAR Level 2 (third-party audit)
certifications.proof_quote: Docusign's CSA STAR participation is via the CAIQ self-assessment (Level 1). No evidence of Level 2 (third-party audit) certification found on docusign.com.

privacy.ai_training_note: Docusign explicitly states it avoids training on identifiable personal customer data: 'We intentionally design our systems with functionality to avoid training models using personal information that customers may enter into our Services (except when we have consent from a customer to do so).' However, de-identified Customer Data may be used for AI model training with customer consent: 'Building, training and maintaining our artificial intelligence models through machine learning that power certain of our Services using de-identified Customer Data (with customer consent).' Customers on enterprise plans should review their service agreements for specific AI data use terms.
privacy.data_region: Australia, United States, European Union, Canada. Enterprise customers can request data residency in specific regions (e.g. EU, Australia, Canada via Azure-based regional deployments).

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256-bit (or most recent FIPS-approved method): 'Encrypt all documents with AES 256-bit encryption or the most recent FIPS-approved methods'

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: HTTPS/TLS, SSL, SSH, IPsec, SFTP: 'all data access and transfer activities use HTTPS and other secure protocols, such as SSL, SSH, IPsec, SFTP, or secure channel signing and sealing'

security.name: Multi-factor authentication
security.value: Supported across all services: 'Multi-factor authentication provides an additional level of assurance that only those authorized to access Docusign eSignature and associated documents can access them'

security.name: Data isolation
security.value: Logical customer data separation: 'Logically separate individual customer data'

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Role-based access controls for all business transaction types; production environment access restricted to maintenance activities with additional security training required

security.name: Non-repudiation
security.value: Certificate of Completion with PKI digital sealing provided for all signed documents

security.name: Audit cadence
security.value: Annual independent audits for SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS; dedicated compliance team provides independent verification

security.name: Vulnerability management
security.value: Threat intelligence capabilities maintained; growing cybersecurity defenses with dedicated security specialists across information security domains

products.name: eSignature
products.data_scope: Agreement content, signer identity data, PHI if healthcare use case (requires BAA). Documents encrypted at rest and in transit.
products.notes: Core product. HIPAA-eligible with proper configuration and signed BAA. FedRAMP authorized for government use. Included in most IAM plans.

products.name: IAM Core (Intelligent Agreement Management)
products.data_scope: Agreement metadata, document content, AI-analyzed contract terms. AI analysis powered by Docusign's own models.
products.notes: AI analysis does not train on personal customer data without consent. De-identified data may be used with consent. FedRAMP authorized.

products.name: Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM)
products.data_scope: Full contract text, party information, workflow data, version history.
products.notes: FedRAMP and DoD IL4 authorized. GovRAMP authorized. Enterprise-only product.

products.name: Identify (Identity Verification)
products.data_scope: Government ID images, biometric facial comparison data, liveness check data. Docusign acts as both processor and controller depending on use.
products.notes: Highest-sensitivity data scope in the Docusign product family. Customers should review DPA carefully. IDV data subject to additional privacy terms.

products.name: Web Forms
products.category: Web form creation and data capture
products.data_scope: Form submission data, routing information, any personal data entered by respondents.
products.notes: Data processed under standard DPA. Included in higher-tier IAM plans.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription tiers: Personal (free tier), Standard, Business Pro (per user/month billed annually), Enterprise (custom pricing). API plans separate. HIPAA-eligible plans start at Business Pro tier.
compare.data_residency: Multi-region cloud (US, EU, Canada, Australia). Enterprise customers can negotiate region-pinned deployments on Azure-backed regional infrastructure. EU data residency available.

flags: HIPAA is not a formal certification: DocuSign supports HIPAA compliance via a signed BAA and correct configuration, but HIPAA is not independently audited like SOC 2. Customers must configure Docusign correctly and execute a BAA; compliance is not automatic.

CSA STAR is Level 1 self-assessment (CAIQ) only: Docusign annually completes the CAIQ and publishes it to the CSA STAR registry, but has not publicly claimed CSA STAR Level 2 (third-party certification). Treat as self-reported.

AI training on de-identified customer data with consent: Docusign does not train on personal customer data by default, but may use de-identified Customer Data for model training when customers consent. Enterprise customers should review their specific agreement terms to confirm opt-out posture.
No ISO 42001 (AI Management System) certification found: Docusign publishes AI Innovation Principles and a trusted AI approach, but does not claim ISO 42001 certification as of June 2026.
No ISO 27701 (Privacy Information Management) certification found on docusign.com: Docusign holds ISO 27018 (cloud privacy) and BCR but does not appear to claim separate ISO 27701 certification.
